description.value:
You fire a concentrated electromagnetic pulse that shreds kinetic shields and fries synthetic circuitry.

Choose a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-tech-overload] save against the creature's power DC. Electricity damage dealt to kinetic shields is doubled by the shield system.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[electricity]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[electricity]] damage. Synthetic or mech creatures take an additional @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[electricity]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[electricity]] damage (plus the synthetic bonus). The target is also Stunned 1.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
